cards.title: Acknowledge Our History
cards.instruction: Make someone recognize that the relationship, memory, or sacrifice mattered and cannot be treated as incidental.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you box that photo, tell me that year mattered.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's only a picture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then say what isn't in the paper.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We were happy there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Now we can pack the picture without packing that away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you box our allotment photo, admit that summer wasn't wasted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We grew three carrots. I need the shelf.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You got out of bed every morning to water those three carrots with me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I could put the photo on my desk at work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Would you? And tell people that part when they laugh at the harvest.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes packing a shared photograph; A3's 'in the paper' is slightly less natural.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's distinction between packing the picture and packing happiness away earns its wordplay through B4.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 makes daily companionship the value of the failed harvest; A5 asks B to preserve that meaning publicly.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's three carrots become A3's evidence of shared effort; B4's desk display prompts A5's request to explain the photograph.

relationship.evidence: B2 needs shelf space and B4 offers a credible compromise that A5 warmly accepts.

heightening.evidence: A5 extends B4's offer from displaying the photograph to defending the significance of their summer.

specificity.evidence: A1's allotment photograph and B2's three-carrot harvest establish an immediately playable disagreement over keepsakes.

brevityWit.evidence: A3 economically reframes the three carrots; A5 returns to the laughable harvest without abandoning the emotional request.

cards.title: Acknowledge Our History

cards.title: Choose the Relationship

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: B
